uncited: This family provides closed-form analytical expressions for the scalar field $f(\vec{x})$ of specific geometric primitives, primarily yielding exact signed Euclidean distances.

Unlike generic implicit surface definitions that may rely on approximations or piecewise kernels, these functions offer precise, singularity-free evaluation for standard shapes like tori, shells, and periodic surfaces, which is critical for robust marching cubes and ray marching in volume rendering.
Implicit primitives are foundational in procedural geometry and volume rendering, allowing for infinite resolution and seamless composition.
